reason: I only hire people another owner I know has used, and nobody round here has heard of a lad working from Kuwait with no UK clients. Pay-when-happy is nice, but it still means calls, scope documents and two rounds of back-and-forth I haven't got time for.
objection: No one I know has used him, and if something breaks on a Saturday I've got nobody local to ring, just a WhatsApp to someone five hours away.
would_change_my_mind: Another Manchester owner I trust telling me he built their site, it was painless and he still answers their WhatsApps months later.
